name: Hit-stop, shake & flash
oneLiner: On a hit the world freezes for a few frames (hit-stop), the play field shakes by whole pixels and decays, and the struck sprite turns white for a frame or two; a finisher freezes longer, shakes harder and flashes the field. Three strengths (light, heavy, finisher), a reduced-motion mode, and a step gate so autoplay and frozen screenshots stay deterministic.
notFor: games whose step is not a fixed update (the gate needs a step to skip)
rhythm or timing games where freezing the world shifts the beat
networked games that must stay in lockstep (freeze every peer or none)
hundreds of hits per second (one freeze counter: rapid hits never stack, but the world keeps stuttering)

needs: a fixed 60 Hz update step the module can gate (its first line), also used by ?t= fast-forward and ?auto=1
hit event on the impact frame: strength (light / heavy / finisher), contact point, target id, blow direction
the play field draw wrapped by begin/end (or the shake offset applied by the game); HUD drawn after
optional: each unit's sprite draw wrapped by sprite(id, rect, fn), or an existing white sprite picked with flashing(id)
optional: UI rects (HUD, banners) the screen flash never covers
optional: hit-stop request (ms) from other effects, routed to freeze(ms) so one counter gates the world
provides: hit-stop: step(dt) returns false while frozen (one freeze counter for every element: freeze(ms))
screen shake: integer offset {x, y} (shake(px, ms) for other elements)
white sprite flash and finisher screen flash
stats(): hits by strength, frozen steps, max offset, flash frames (for tests)

assets: module/hit-stop-shake.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_HitStop): step gate, freeze counter with a chain cap, seeded decaying integer shake, pixel-diff sprite flash, finisher screen flash, contact-flash fallback; colours through GameDNA_Skin (built-in pixel16 fallback)
